semantics: Sparse same-head companionship; no work/event assertion. All targets already had indefinite canonical-neutral loops.
ordinaryExit: Current half -> canonical open eyes; shut -> half -> canonical. Never replay a future blink.
pickup: Immediate same-eye same-pose detached body, reopen eyes through half if needed, then the existing matching canonical pickup.
release: Immediate same-eye seated counterpart, reopen through half if needed and settle at matching original canonical. Latest intent wins.
pauseSafe: Only canonical open-eye holds; never freeze half/shut.
